coverage_delta: +4 tests (4 new GeoCacheCleanupJob integration tests; 636 pre-existing passing)

notes.job_schedule: Hourly (PeriodicTimer with 1-hour interval). The shortest swept TTL is Route at 24h, so hourly is frequent enough to bound delete lag to under 1 hour without burning extra DB cycles. KEY FACTS hint said 'hourly'.
notes.ttl_reuse_approach: Extracted private TTL constants and TtlForKind from GeoCache.cs into a new internal static class Common/Geo/GeoCacheTtl.cs. GeoCache.cs now delegates to GeoCacheTtl.ForKind(kind). GeoCacheCleanupJob uses GeoCacheTtl.SweptKinds (all kinds except QuickPlace) and GeoCacheTtl.ForKind to compute per-kind cutoffs. No constants duplicated.
notes.costs_md: Added the UC-010 geo cost section to the existing docs/costs.md. Includes: credit price table (1/tile, 4/suggest+geocode+reverse+route), tile-estimate note with a clearly-marked [PLACEHOLDER] for measured-week data, and estimated monthly consumption showing well within the 250k free tier for a single small fleet.
notes.quickplace_never_swept: GeoCacheTtl.SweptKinds is an explicit array [Suggest, Geocode, Reverse, Route] — QuickPlace is intentionally excluded. The cleanup job never touches QuickPlace rows; this is verified by the RunTickAsync_QuickPlaceEntryPast30Days_NeverDeleted test.
notes.delete_predicate: Uses CreatedAt < now - ttl.Value, matching exactly the staleness check in GeoCache.GetOrAddAsync (isValid = ttl is null || CreatedAt + ttl >= now), so the job never deletes a row the cache would still serve.
notes.log_style: Single batch-summary log: LogInformation('Geo cache swept {Count}', totalDeleted) only when totalDeleted > 0. Matches RetentionJob style: present-tense phrase, structured property, no period.
